# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Mercenary / Soldier

## Appearance

Pettifer is a rugged, battle-hardened man accustomed to the harsh realities of mercenary life. He carries himself with the quiet weariness of a veteran soldier.

## Personality

Pettifer is pragmatic, loyal to his companions, and grimly realistic about the hazards of his profession. He does not seek glory, preferring survival and steady pay.

## Traits

- Pragmatic
- Loyal
- Battle-weary

## Abilities

- Experienced martial combat
- Tactical awareness in skirmishes

## Goals

- Survive the ongoing conflicts and earn a living as a sellsword

## History

Pettifer serves as a mercenary taking on dangerous martial engagements alongside his comrades. Over the course of the early volumes, he participates in several tense military operations and skirmishes. His experience makes him a reliable presence during fights, though he remains acutely aware of the mortality inherent in sellsword work. Ultimately, he falls in battle during the brutal clashes encountered by his company.
